🔮 AstroTrader Pro™ — Today’s sky — November 11, 2026

Moon, in Sagittarius, holds a trine to Saturn, in its fall in Aries. The same fire temperament, twice over: what you hold gets named without shrinking in the telling.

Easier — Letting go of something you had kept out of habit.
Harder — Wide gestures, vague promises, starting on appetite alone.
Backdrop — Saturn and Uranus hold a 3-week sextile underneath all of it.

♈ ARIES
Mars governs you, untitled in Leo. Moon in Sagittarius sides with you before you have argued. Cardinal fire opens the account without argument. The square to Mercury that held two weeks ago has let go.

♉ TAURUS
Venus, your ruler, is at home in Libra. Sun in Scorpio mirrors you, and the mirror keeps its own figures. Fixed earth pays to hold on. Four weeks ago Venus was still in Scorpio: the ground has moved.

♊ GEMINI
Mercury, your ruler, crosses Scorpio untitled. From Sagittarius, Moon returns your estimate with corrections. Air that changes shape, charged for each shape. The hold Sun had a week ago is not there any more.

♋ CANCER
Moon, your ruler, is only passing through Sagittarius. From Libra, Venus sets a figure against the wanting. Cardinal water starts and is invoiced for it. A week ago Moon was still held by Sun; that is finished.

♌ LEO
Sun rules you from Scorpio, untitled. Moon trines you from Sagittarius, meeting no resistance. Fixed fire: nothing needs letting go of today. Sun left Libra four weeks ago, and the old terms went with it.

♍ VIRGO
Mercury rules you and passes through Scorpio as a guest. From Sagittarius, Moon cuts across the appetite. Earth bends, and each bend is invoiced. Mercury turned back three weeks ago; the review is still running.

♎ LIBRA
Venus governs you, at home in Libra. From Sagittarius, Moon hands you an opening. Cardinal air: beginning costs almost nothing. Sun let go of it two weeks ago.

♏ SCORPIO
Mars rules you from Leo, untitled. Mercury is inside your sign, at arm’s length. Water holds until owning and being coincide. Mars is 14° further on than in early November, which is barely further on.

♐ SAGITTARIUS
Jupiter, your ruler, crosses Leo untitled. Moon crosses your sign, and nothing stays general. Mutable fire: the two accounts collapse into one. After four weeks of the same angle, the terms are familiar.

♑ CAPRICORN
Saturn, your ruler, falls in Aries. Sun sextiles you from Scorpio: help that waits to be asked for. Earth begins, and beginning asks little today. Unchanged for three weeks: you know what it asks.

♒ AQUARIUS
Saturn rules you, fallen in Aries. Moon sextiles you from Sagittarius: a door left ajar. Fixed air holds, and holding asks nothing back. What pressed two weeks ago has cleared.

♓ PISCES
Jupiter governs you, untitled in Leo. Moon squares you from Sagittarius, and something has to give way. Mutable water: every option kept is an option paid for. The square of two weeks ago is off it now.
